messages:
kira-docs: Quick flag from todays onboarding: the `starter-workshop` README has a couple of small copy/paste drifts that are causing 401s and confusion.

ben-se: What specifically?

kira-docs: 1) curl snippet uses header `X-Api-Key: $REDWOOD_KEY` (nonstandard) while our API and SDKs expect `Authorization: Bearer <KEY>`. 2) docker-compose uses `REDWOOD_API_KEY` but README shows `export REDWOOD_KEY=...`. Folks copy/paste and get 401s.

morgan-qa: Repro: clone, docker-compose up, run README curl -> 401. The compose file maps `REDWOOD_API_KEY` into the container so the README env var name is wrong.

eli-devex: Oof. Also saw the README text saying "SDK retries are automatic for transient failures" which is misleading. Our clients do limited retries by default; production users should configure backoff and retry policy explicitly.

ben-se: I can open a small PR to: (a) standardize env var to `REDWOOD_API_KEY`, (b) change curl to `-H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY"`, (c) update the README note about retries to: "SDKs provide limited automatic retries for transient errors; configure retry/backoff for production via SDK options.", and (d) update language-specific examples to the current ctor shapes.

kira-docs: Please add before/after snippets in the PR description and a tiny smoke job in CI that runs the curl against a mocked endpoint so we catch future drift. That test can be super small (python http.server).

ben-se: Will do. Also adding a one-line Troubleshooting bullet: "401 -> confirm env var name and that Authorization header uses Bearer <KEY> (not X-Api-Key or Token)."

ci-bot: PR opened by ben-se: https://github.com/redwood-inference/starter-workshop/pull/77  CI: sample-smoke-test started.

kira-docs: Thanks! After merge I'll update the quickstart landing page and the onboarding checklist so support can close the related tickets.

morgan-qa: Nice, should cut a bunch of first-day support noise.
